name: Erg Chebbi: the big dune at sunrise
why: On foot from the edge of Merzouga up the soft crest of the highest dune of Erg Chebbi, about 150 m, to watch the sun rise over the Sahara.
book: Free from the village; camps and camel rides are paid.
dangers: Heat after 10:00 from April to October.
